name: Plenoxel
definition: A method that relaxes the PlenOctrees assumption of constant opacity and spherical harmonic coefficients inside each voxel by using trilinear interpolation to define a continuous function throughout the volume.
summary: Plenoxel is a neural network-free radiance field representation that uses trilinear interpolation on a sparse 3D grid to model continuous opacity and spherical harmonic coefficients, distinguishing itself from PlenOctels by relaxing the assumption of constant values within voxels.
